svg.title: Tarpon 11-weight — leader diagram
svg.desc: Leader schematic for Tarpon 11-weight: 4 ft · 40 lb Hard mono butt, then 2 ft · 20 lb Class tippet (fluorocarbon), then 1 ft · 60 lb Bite tippet (fluorocarbon).
svg.text: When: Migratory adult tarpon. Resident juveniles are a 9–10
weight with 30–40 lb bite and no ceremony.
Not to scale — lengths are on the labels.
